## York Space Systems to Hold Investor Call to Discuss York’s Unmanned Space Architecture and Planned Outlook Acquisition


November 17, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s21.q4cdn.com/622448243/files/doc_news/York-Space-Systems-to-Hold-Investor-Call-to-Discuss-Yorks-Unmanned-Space-Architecture-and-Planned-Outlook-Acquisition-2026.pdf)


DENVER--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


York Space Systems Inc. (NYSE: YSS) will hold a call to discuss its space architecture for unmanned vehicles and its planned acquisition of Outlook after the close of market on Thursday, November 19, 2026. Listeners may access the conference call live via an audio webcast.


Photograph of Shadow, the initial platform planned for York Terrestrial Systems, is a long-endurance unmanned ground system designed for persistent intelligence and mobile communications in demanding operational environments.


Thursday, November 19, 2026


3:00 pm Mountain Time (5:00 pm Eastern Time)


Webcast:[https://ir.yorkspacesystems.com/events-and-presentations/default.aspx](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fir.yorkspacesystems.com%2Fevents-and-presentations%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54642991&newsitemid=20261117010855&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fir.yorkspacesystems.com%2Fevents-and-presentations%2Fdefault.aspx&index=1&md5=bb04df2dce9a422000fdfd820679b40e)


A replay of the conference call will be available for one year at[http://ir.yorkspacesystems.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fir.yorkspacesystems.com&esheet=54642991&newsitemid=20261117010855&lan=en-US&anchor=http%3A%2F%2Fir.yorkspacesystems.com&index=2&md5=760976f32dcdfa9e146d6622197c954c) .


**About York Space Systems**


[York Space Systems](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.yorkspacesystems.com%2F&esheet=54642991&newsitemid=20261117010855&lan=en-US&anchor=York+Space+Systems&index=3&md5=5b5b45268dcf4836905496be24507a51) (NYSE: YSS) is a leading, U.S.-based national defense and commercial prime providing a comprehensive suite of mission-critical solutions for national security, government, and commercial customers. York is one of the only space and defense primes with proprietary hardware and software capabilities designed to address customers’ complex mission requirements across the critical elements of the entire space ecosystem throughout the mission lifecycle. York is purpose built to address evolving national security space challenges and to adapt to the ongoing shift in the U.S. government’s mission needs and procurement processes.
